find_universities_by_domain.description: Find the universities that use a domain, or an ending of one. 'ac.uk' returns the British universities, 'edu.tr' the Turkish ones, and an exact domain returns whoever holds it, which is more than one university for four domains in the list. A suffix only counts at a dot, so 'ac.uk' cannot match a domain that merely ends in those letters. Use this to work out what an academic domain looks like in a country before you write a rule about it. No API key required.
find_universities_by_domain.name: find_universities_by_domain

parameters.description: The domain or the ending to look for, such as 'ac.uk', 'edu.tr' or 'mit.edu'. A leading 'www.', a scheme and a path are all stripped, so a pasted URL works.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: How the text has to line up with a domain. 'Ends with' is the default and only counts whole labels, so 'ac.uk' finds ox.ac.uk. 'Contains' is looser and will find a fragment anywhere.
parameters.name: match

options.label: The domain ends with this, e.g. ac.uk

parameters.description: Only universities in this country. Takes an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (TR, JP, GB), the name the list writes, or a common alias: 'Turkey' reaches Turkiye, 'South Korea' reaches Korea, Republic of, and 'UK' and 'USA' both work. The country is resolved to its code before anything is matched, which is what makes one filter find all 60 Vietnamese universities when the records spell the country two ways. Leave empty for every country. Run 'List countries' to see them.

Optionally require a country, so 'is this a Japanese university address' is one field rather than a second step. Built for screening a signup sheet or a spreadsheet column, so the result carries the pass and fail counts and the entries that failed as well as the rows themselves. description: Look up universities by their email domains from a workflow. The University Domains and Names list holds about 10,000 universities in 200 countries, each with its name, its country and ISO code, the state or province where the list names one, every email domain it uses and its web pages. Turn a signup address into a university and a country, screen a whole list of addresses at once and optionally require a country, or find a university by name, by country and state, or by domain ending such as ac.uk. A departmental address resolves upwards, so an address at cs.usc.edu finds the University of Southern California. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything, in the list or anywhere else. No account or API key required.
